sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-RTX5090: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-RTX5090 is a quantized checkpoint of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B language model optimized for NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs using NVIDIA's Model Optimizer tool. Built by gittensor-model-hub, this checkpoint compresses the original 53 GB BF16 model to 18.8 GB in VRAM while maintaining the full native 262,144-token context window on a 32 GB RTX 5090.
